# Average acceleration

<!-- STEP id="definition" -->
Average acceleration = change in velocity / time interval.

If the velocity changes from u at time t1 to v at time t2, then a = (v - u) / (t2 - t1).

<!-- STEP id="unit" -->
Velocity is in m/s and time in s, so acceleration is in metre per second per second: **m/s²**.
